title: Boxing inequalities for relative fractional perimeter and fractional Poincaré-type inequalities on John domains with the BBM factor
summary: For $0<δ,τ<1$ and $1\le s\le \frac{n}{n-δ}$, we prove that for a given $s$-John domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$, the following Boxing inequality holds for every Lebesgue measurable set $U\subsetΩ$ with $|U|/|Ω|\leγ<1$: \[ \mathcal{H}^{s(n-δ)}_{\infty}(U\setminus\mathcal{N}_U)\le C(1-δ)\int_Ω\int_{|x-y|<τ\operatorname{dist}(y,\partialΩ)}\frac{|χ_U(x)-χ_U(y)|}{|x-y|^{n+δ}}\,dx\,dy, \] where $\mathcal{H}^{s(n-δ)}_{\infty}(U)$ denotes the $s(n-δ)$-dimensional Hausdorff content of $U$, $\mathcal{N}_U$ is a set of Lebesgue measure zero and the constant $C$ depends only on $n,τ,s,γ$, the John…
